identities.name: moving_slope_orthoframe
identities.statement: For kappa^2=b^2+eta^2 rho, e_L=(eta sqrt(rho) xi+b v)/kappa and e_P=(b xi-eta sqrt(rho) v)/kappa are orthonormal whenever xi,v are orthonormal; both are orthogonal to w.

identities.name: fixed_P_core_determinant
identities.statement: For the homogeneous (X0,L0,W) core after fixing P, det B_P=(c b^2/kappa^2) det M; the hub/L0 coefficient is beta=sqrt(c) kappa and the W^2 coefficient is gamma, hence beta^2 gamma det B_P=c^2 b^2 gamma det M.

identities.name: transverse_gamma_gate
identities.statement: With z=(delta,0,-b), Mz=(eta delta,0,-gamma b). If s_min(M)>=1, |eta|<=1 and b!=0, then |gamma|>=1.

identities.name: square_preimage_Borel_bound
identities.statement: For gamma!=0 and any Borel E of finite measure, Leb{w: gamma(w-a)^2 in E} <= 2 |E|^(1/2)/sqrt(|gamma|), uniformly in the center a.

scope: Supporting exact-rank-three heavy near-null reduction only; full QFORM and full continuity remain open.
